player_prompt.intro:
U na tšameka 2048 ka boradiso {board_size}x{board_size}. Toro ya hao ke ya fihla tile {target_tile} ka go tsamaya dinomoro tšo fanang ka moka!
Matšofo a mantle: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles di kopana ha di kwano, di gopolang sethalo sa tšona.

invalid_move.no_change: Boto ha ea ka ea fetoha - e ile ea khetha tsela e fapaneng.

outcome.win: Polelo, o fihletse {target_tile}! Skoer ya morao {score}.
outcome.lose: Ga ho na matšofo. Tile e kholo {max_tile} - skoer ya morao {score}.
